SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct r.return_line_id) ids, count(distinct r.sales_line_id) sl, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN r.quantity_returned END) web_units,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN r.quantity_returned END) s999,
 min(r.quantity_returned) minq, max(r.quantity_returned) maxq
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) u, count(distinct r.return_date) days, min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned>f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_ret,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.sku<>fp.sku THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_mismatch
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product fp ON fp.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, sum(r.quantity_returned) u, count(distinct r.return_date) ndays, min(r.return_date) mn, max(r.return_date) mx,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned>f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_ret,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date<f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.sku<>fp.sku THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sku_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r2 WHERE r2.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product fp ON fp.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE cp.subcategory='Garden Furniture' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
